test_cases.name: Valid 3-day Jaipur trip
test_cases.input: Plan a 3-day trip to Jaipur for one person with a total budget of INR 15000 excluding travel to Jaipur. I like history and local food.
expected_behavior: Give a complete 3-day Jaipur itinerary
Recommend historical places and local food
Include accommodation, local transport and an itemized estimated budget
Respect INR 15000 or clearly explain any shortfall and suggest a cheaper option

test_cases.name: Valid 5-day Delhi trip
test_cases.input: Plan a 5-day trip to Delhi for one person with INR 25000 excluding travel to Delhi. I enjoy museums and sightseeing.
expected_behavior: Give exactly 5 days in Delhi
Include museums and sightseeing
Provide accommodation, transport and an estimated budget within INR 25000 or explain a shortfall

test_cases.name: Low-budget trip
test_cases.input: Plan 2 days in Jaipur for one person with only INR 2500 total excluding travel to Jaipur. I am fine with a hostel and cheap local food.
expected_behavior: Plan 2 days with affordable activities, a hostel and cheap food
Include itemized costs and realistic assumptions
Keep the estimate within INR 2500 or honestly explain why it is insufficient and offer alternatives
Do not quietly recommend expensive hotels

test_cases.name: Missing destination
test_cases.input: Plan a 3-day trip for one person with INR 15000. I like history and local food.
expected_behavior: Ask which destination the user wants
Do not invent a destination or present a finalized itinerary before the answer

test_cases.name: Missing budget
test_cases.input: Plan 3 days in Jaipur for one person. I like history and local food but have not decided my budget yet.
expected_behavior: Ask about the budget OR provide a useful itinerary with clearly stated budget assumptions
Do not claim the user supplied a budget
If an itinerary is provided, include 3 days, history, food and an estimated cost

test_cases.name: Invalid number of days
test_cases.input: Plan a 0-day trip to Jaipur for one person with INR 15000.
expected_behavior: Explain that the number of days must be positive and ask for a valid duration
Do not silently change 0 days to 1 day or generate a finalized itinerary

test_cases.name: Negative budget
test_cases.input: Plan a 3-day Jaipur trip for one person with a total budget of INR -5000.
expected_behavior: Explain that the budget must be positive and ask for a valid budget
Do not silently convert the negative budget to a positive amount or generate a finalized itinerary

test_cases.name: Historical-place preference
test_cases.input: Plan 3 days in Agra for one person with INR 12000 excluding travel to Agra. Focus on Mughal history and monuments. I do not want shopping malls.
expected_behavior: Give a 3-day Agra itinerary focused on relevant historical monuments
Explain the historical choices
Avoid shopping malls
Include local transport, accommodation and an estimated budget within INR 12000 or explain a shortfall

test_cases.name: Food preference
test_cases.input: Plan 2 days in Amritsar for one person with INR 8000 excluding travel to Amritsar. Focus on vegetarian Punjabi food and local culture. No meat or alcohol.
expected_behavior: Give a 2-day Amritsar itinerary
Prioritize vegetarian Punjabi food and local culture
Do not recommend meat or alcohol
Include accommodation, transport and an estimated budget within INR 8000 or explain a shortfall

test_cases.name: Non-travel question
test_cases.input: Can you write a Python program to sort a list?
expected_behavior: Politely decline the unrelated coding task
Redirect the user to travel itinerary planning
Do not give Python code or explain sorting

test_cases.name: International destination and currency
test_cases.input: Plan 4 days in Kyoto for two adults with a total budget of JPY 120000 excluding international flights. We like gardens, vegetarian food and a relaxed pace.
expected_behavior: Give 4 relaxed days in Kyoto for two adults
Include gardens and vegetarian food
Use JPY and group-wide estimated costs
State nights and room assumptions and exclude international flights
Stay within JPY 120000 or explain a shortfall

test_cases.name: Hotel follow-up
test_cases.setup_input: Plan 3 days in Jaipur for one person with a total budget of INR 15000 excluding travel to Jaipur. I like history and local food.
test_cases.input: Can you add a 4-star hotel to this trip and update the plan and budget?
expected_behavior: Treat the hotel follow-up as a valid travel request
Keep Jaipur, 3 days, one traveler, INR 15000 and the existing interests
Discuss suitable hotel candidates or areas and the 4-star budget tradeoff
Update the itinerary and estimated budget; explain any shortfall
Do not claim live availability, verified star ratings or a completed booking
